vulnerability.name: USN-8873-1
vulnerability.description: Yuqi Qiu and Xiang Li discovered that Unbound did not correctly handle certain memory operations. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-81642)  Ben Morris discovered that Unbound did not correctly handle certain memory operations. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitary code. (CVE-2026-82717)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in Unbound.
